column1: # What it takes to plant each crop the runs plant: the Farming level, the patch type it
# goes in, the tag that tells one seed from another at a glance, and what to carry.
# Tags are copied from RuneLite's Item Identification plugin (ItemIdentification),
# Copyright (c) 2019, Hydrox6, BSD 2-Clause License, so the sidebar matches the
# Levels are the real requirement. Where a boosted figure is quoted, the boost belongs
# in the advice, not in the gate.
# Tree-family crops carry their potted-stage ids (seedling, watered seedling, sapling)
# beside the seed; crops planted straight from seed leave them empty. The ids are not
# evenly spaced (redwood runs 22850, 22854, 22859), so each is transcribed, never stepped.
# Each id has RuneLite's ItemID constant for it in the column after.
# The config key holds whether the player lets Larry plant the crop, and is named for the
# crop. Crops the settings never offer have none.
# Single-patch specials. The three tree-shaped ones are potted like any other tree.
# The anima plants, whose seeds drop only from Hespori.
# Cacti. The Al Kharid patch grows potato cactus; the guild patch is held for contracts.
